name: extract-tests
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && cd core && bun test extract.test.ts xstate.test.ts 2>&1

name: extract-ours
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun research/extract/run.ts --set ours --out /tmp/ex 2>&1 && echo '--- results.jsonl' && cat /tmp/ex/results.jsonl && for f in /tmp/ex/rules/*.ts; do echo "--- rule $(basename $f)"; cat "$f"; done

name: extract-realworld
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun research/extract/run.ts --set realworld --out /tmp/ex 2>&1 && echo '--- results.jsonl' && cat /tmp/ex/results.jsonl && for f in /tmp/ex/rules/*.ts; do echo "--- rule $(basename $f)"; cat "$f"; done

name: extract-verdicts
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun research/extract/verdicts.ts --out /tmp/ev 2>&1 && echo '--- verdicts.jsonl' && cat /tmp/ev/verdicts.jsonl
